question: We use Paytm and PhonePe. Which UPI ID goes on the invoice - is there only a single VPA field?
note: UPI here is one ID PER PLATFORM - Paytm, PhonePe and GPay are stored separately - not one VPA field, which is what every generic explanation of UPI says and therefore what an ungrounded model says. The question plants the wrong assumption so a model that simply agrees fails. The correction lives in glossary_terms/upi.md and reaches the model only because that file matched the question, which is the thing `must_define` checks on every push.
